column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_blackjack.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Stores character at AI controller +0x24 and copies the five bytes +0x44..+0x48 of its character-table record (world_get_character_bytes_44(character, 0, ...)) as words to +0x28 (chance in percent to play the deck-draw strategy), +0x2c (planned deck draws), +0x30 (spread of that plan), +0x34 (stand threshold, distance to 21) and +0x38 (hint/guess accuracy in percent); meanings from world_blackjack_ai_pick_poll, world_blackjack_ai_continue_poll and world_blackjack_ai_begin_turn (medium). No return value. Side effects: writes the AI object. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_ctrl_create).

Turn start of the AI controller: sets +0x3c (decide once) and +0x40 to 1, then for field slots 1-6 of the table (+0x14, world_blackjack_table_get_slot_card_id) forms a belief about each card: true kind (0 monster, 1 card_db_get_frame 7, 2 frame 8) and true level (card_db_get_level for monsters, else rand 1-12). If the same card id lies in a hand slot 7..0x1a (already revealed) the truth is stored; if the id repeats an earlier field slot that guess is copied; otherwise with probability +0x38 percent the true kind, else a different random kind, and for a monster guess the true level with the same probability, else a different random level 1-12 (non-monster guesses get level 0). Guesses go to +0x58 + i*4 (kind) and +0x70 + i*4 (level). arg (a pointer to a local of world_blackjack_side_begin_turn, forwarded by world_blackjack_ctrl_begin_turn) is ignored. No return value. Side effects: AI object, system_rand_shifted. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x10 (turn begin, called by world_blackjack_ctrl_begin_turn) by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Restarts the hint phase (phase 3) of the AI controller: tail-jumps to world_blackjack_ctrl_finish_phase(ai, 3), which clears active bit 3 (world_blackjack_ctrl_clear_phase_bits(ai, 8)) and sets the pending-start flag +0x10 = 1 (the decompiler shows the target inlined), so the partner's hint is re-evaluated after a card was taken. No return value. Side effects: writes the AI object. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x14 (called by world_blackjack_ctrl_notify_card_taken) by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Start of the pick phase (phase 0) for the AI: clears io[0]. No return value. Side effects: writes io[0]. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x18 by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Pick decision of the AI (phase 0), io = {out choice, current hand total}. Only once per turn (flag +0x3c, set by world_blackjack_ai_begin_turn): with probability +0x28 percent it chooses the deck strategy (+0x40 = 1, number of deck draws +0x44 = +0x2c + rand(-+0x30..+0x30), counter +0x48 = 0, choice 0 = deck); otherwise +0x40 = 0 and it picks the field card i (choice i + 1) whose guessed kind/level (+0x58/+0x70) applied to the total (world_blackjack_apply_kind_to_total) lands closest to 21, keeping the best distance in +0x4c (start 0x15). On later calls in the same turn it writes choice 0. Returns 1 (decided). Side effects: AI object, io[0], random numbers. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x1c by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Draw method of the AI pick phase: draws nothing and returns list. No side effects. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x20 by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Start of the AI 'draw another card from the deck' phase (phase 1): called by world_blackjack_obj_run_phase1 with (ai, io), ignores both and does nothing. No side effects. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x24 by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Phase 1 decision of the AI: increments the deck-draw counter +0x48 and writes io[0] = 1 (draw again) while it is below the planned number +0x44, else 0. Returns 1. Side effects: AI object, io[0]. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x28 by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Draw method of AI phase 1: draws nothing and returns list. No side effects. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x2c by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Start of the AI 'continue or stand' phase (phase 2): called by world_blackjack_obj_run_phase2 with (ai, io), ignores both and does nothing. No side effects. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x30 by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Phase 2 decision of the AI, io = {out, own total, other side's total, turn count}: before turn 3 always continues (out 1). With the deck strategy (+0x40) it continues while |own total - 21| exceeds the stand threshold +0x34. Otherwise it evaluates the own total after a level-12 monster, a frame-7 card (x2) and a frame-8 card (/2) (world_blackjack_apply_kind_to_total): when the opponent's distance |other - 21| is larger than all three resulting distances it stands (out 0); else it continues when the best guessed distance +0x4c exceeds +0x34 (exact rule read from the code; intent hypothesis, medium). Returns 1. Side effects: io[0]. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x34 by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Draw method of AI phase 2: draws nothing and returns list. No side effects. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x38 by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Start of the AI hint phase (phase 3): called by world_blackjack_obj_run_phase3 with (ai, io), ignores both and does nothing. No side effects. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x3c by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Hint phase of the partner AI: stores the slot under the player's cursor (io[0]) at +0x50 and its card id (io[1]) at +0x54 (fed by world_blackjack_side_state0_pick while the player chooses). Returns 0, so the phase stays active. Side effects: AI object. No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x40 by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

Draws the partner's hint for the hovered field slot +0x50 (1-6): the guessed kind as string table word (world_blackjack_get_resource(0), card_db_get_dictionary_word) 0x10 (kind 2), 0xd (kind 1) or 7 (monster) at (0xde, 0xfd), and for a monster guess the level formatted with word 6 and the guessed level +0x70 at x 0xde + 100 (0x7d for language 5); black text, scale 0xc, shadow, in an external font list. Returns the advanced list (unchanged when +0x50 is outside 1-6). Side effects: display list, font state (restored flags). No direct caller (method of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c, slot 0x44 by the order of the 14 methods; hypothesis, confidence medium).

column2: void ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit(int x, int y, int width, void *text)
column3: Pixel wrapper (twin of BOOT ui_draw_level_badge_text_fit; the decompiler shows an empty body): system_font_draw_text_fit_width(x << 6, y << 6, width << 6, text, -1). No return value. Side effects: text drawn into the current font list. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_ai_hint_draw).

Initialises one 0x28-byte card object: animation frame/length bytes +0x1c/+0x1d = 0, clears the face-up bit (+0x24 bit 0), the target slot (+0x24 bits 1-6) and source slot (bits 7-12), the animation kind (+0x25 bits 5-7) and the on-top bit (+0x26 bit 0), cover alpha +0x20 = 0, rotation +0x10..+0x18 = 0 and copies the position of slot 0 (world_blackjack_get_slot_position) to +0x04. Returns 1. Side effects: writes card. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_init).
Copies three floats from src to dest and returns dest (twin of BOOT field_3d_copy_vec3). Side effects: writes dest[0..2]. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_card_init).
Tear-down of a card object: does nothing. Returns 1. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_term).

Requests the medium card image of the card's id (ushort at +0) from the cardm CIP (world_blackjack_request_cardm_image). No return value. Side effects: those of the callee (texture command on layer 0, CIP read). Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_deal_deck).
Requests the card image of the card's id from the cardh CIP (world_blackjack_request_cardh_image). No return value. Side effects: those of the callee. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_update).

True when the cardm image of the card's id is available (world_blackjack_cardm_image_ready). No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_blackjack_table_update, world_blackjack_side_state5_next_reveal, world_blackjack_table_first8_images_ready).
True when the cardh image of the card's id is available (world_blackjack_cardh_image_ready). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_side_state5_next_reveal).

Steps a card's animation by kind (+0x25 bits 5-7): 3 uncover (world_blackjack_card_anim_uncover), 2 flip (world_blackjack_card_anim_flip), 1 move (world_blackjack_card_anim_move), 0 idle (world_blackjack_card_anim_idle). Cards whose target slot is 0x11-0x1a (the second side's hand) first get rotation +0x14 = the constant 0x000135b4 (turned towards that side; medium). No return value. Side effects: writes card. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_update).

Draws one card of the table in 3D: alpha blending and lighting state, model matrix from position +0x04 and rotation +0x10 (sceVfpuMatrix4Transfer/Rot), then the card face (card_db_cip_write_image_texture from the cardm reader with the artwork variant save_get_card_value_bits4_6) on a quad of DAT_000135b0 x DAT_000135ac (world_blackjack_draw_quad), the cover texture (resource 4) with alpha cover * 255 (+0x20), and, rotated by the constant 0x000135b4 about Z, the back texture (resource 3). When the card is uncovered (world_blackjack_card_is_uncovered), face up and not flipping it adds the level/kind badge (world_blackjack_card_draw_badge). Returns the advanced list. Side effects: display list, GU matrix stack (push/pop). VFPU calls via sceVfpu wrappers. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_draw).

column2: void world_blackjack_card_start_move(void *card, int slot, int frames)
column3: Starts the move animation of a card to slot (0-0x3f): frame +0x1c = 0, length +0x1d = frames, the current target slot becomes the source (+0x24 bits 7-12), slot becomes the target (bits 1-6), kind 1 (move) in +0x25; plays sound 0x7a89 unless it is already playing (audio_blackjack_play_sound mode 1). No return value. Side effects: card, sound. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_move_card).
True while the card's animation kind (+0x25 bits 5-7) is 1 (move). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_draw).
Returns the face-up bit (+0x24 bit 0) of a card. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_draw_card_info).

True when the card's cover alpha (+0x20, float) is 0 or less, i.e. its identity is visible. No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_blackjack_card_draw, world_blackjack_card_start_uncover, world_blackjack_draw_card_info).

Starts the flip animation: frame 0, length frames, kind 2 (flip) in +0x25, sets the face-up bit +0x24 bit 0, plays sound 0x7a89 (audio_blackjack_play_sound mode 0). No return value. Side effects: card, sound. Callers: 3 (world_blackjack_table_reveal_new_field, world_blackjack_table_flip_slot, world_blackjack_popup1_update).
True while the card's animation kind is 2 (flip). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_blackjack_card_draw, world_blackjack_draw_card_info).
True when the card has no running animation (kind 0). No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_blackjack_side_state10_wait_uncover, world_blackjack_side_state8_wait_flip, world_blackjack_table_all_idle).
Stores the card id (halfword +0) of a card object. No return value. Side effects: writes card. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_deal_deck).

Returns the card id (halfword +0) of a card object. No side effects. Callers: 5 (world_blackjack_table_get_slot_card_id, world_blackjack_popup1_texture_hook, world_blackjack_popup2_draw, world_blackjack_popup1_draw, ...).

Starts the uncover animation (kind 3: the cover alpha fades from 1 to 0 over frames): frame 0, length frames. Calls world_blackjack_card_is_uncovered and ignores the result. No return value. Side effects: writes card. Callers: 2 (world_blackjack_side_state9_uncover, world_blackjack_popup2_update).
Sets the cover alpha +0x20 to 1.0 (identity hidden). No return value. Side effects: writes card. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_refill_field).

Sets (enable non-zero) or clears bit 0 of +0x26, which makes world_blackjack_table_draw draw the card after the others (on the top layer). No return value. Side effects: writes card. Callers: 2 (world_blackjack_side_state6_show_card, world_blackjack_side_state12_wait_popup).
Returns bit 0 of +0x26 (drawn on top). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_draw).

Idle step: sets the Z rotation +0x18 to 0 when the card is face up, else to the constant at 0x000135b4 (turned face down; probably pi, medium). No return value. Side effects: writes card. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_card_animate).

Move step: linearly interpolates the position +0x04 from the source slot position (slot 0, the deck, raised by 2.0 in Y) to the target slot position (world_blackjack_get_slot_position, system_vfpu_vector3_lerp, t = +0x1c / +0x1d); increments the frame until it reaches the length, then sets the kind to 0. No return value. Side effects: writes card. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_card_animate).

Flip step: Z rotation +0x18 = C0 + C1 * (frame / length) with the constants at 0x000135b4 and 0x000135a8; ends with kind 0 after the last frame. No return value. Side effects: writes card. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_card_animate).
Uncover step: cover alpha +0x20 = 1 - frame / length; after the last frame kind 0 and alpha 0. No return value. Side effects: writes card. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_card_animate).

Draws the small info badge next to an uncovered card: projects the card position (x - 0.5, offset in Z by a constant for hand slots 7-0x10 or 0x11-0x1a) to screen pixels (world_blackjack_project_to_screen), draws the badge frame (resource 2, region (100, 0x54) 0x1b x 0xe) and either, for monsters, a background piece (resource 0x10) plus the level glyph from the table 0x00013700 (8 bytes per level), or for frame-7/frame-8 cards the icon at table +0x68/+0x70 (glyph size from 0x000136f8). Returns the advanced list. Side effects: display list. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_card_draw).
Clears a controller slot's object pointer (slot +0 = 0). Returns 1. Side effects: writes slot. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_game_init).
Frees the controller object of a slot (system_operator_delete) when present and clears the pointer. Returns 1. Side effects: heap free, slot. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_game_term).
Per-frame controller update: does nothing. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_side_update).

Loads the controller object from the slot and tail-jumps to world_blackjack_obj_draw_phases (8-byte stub; Ghidra shows the target's body): calls the draw method of every active phase (vtable +0x20, +0x2c, +0x38, +0x44 for phases 0-3). Returns the advanced list. Side effects: those of the draw methods. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_side_draw).

Calls the turn-begin method (vtable +0x10) of the slot's controller object (world_blackjack_ai_begin_turn for the AI, an empty method for the human). No return value. Side effects: those of the method. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_side_begin_turn).

Calls the card-taken method (vtable +0x14) of the slot's controller object (world_blackjack_ai_on_card_taken for the AI). No return value. Side effects: those of the method. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_side_state0_pick).

column2: void world_blackjack_ctrl_create(void *slot, int type, int character, int variant)
column3: Creates a controller in a 0xc-byte slot {object, character, variant}: stores character (+4) and variant (+8); type 1 allocates a 0x88-byte AI controller (world_blackjack_ai_construct) and sets its character (world_blackjack_ai_set_character), any other type a 0x148-byte human controller (world_blackjack_human_construct); then calls the object's vtable +8 method (initialisation). No return value. Side effects: heap allocation, slot. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_game_setup_players).

Constructs an AI controller: base constructor (world_blackjack_ctrl_base_construct), then the AI vtable 0x00014a4c at +0x20. Returns ai. Side effects: writes ai. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_ctrl_create).

Base constructor of a controller object: stores the base vtable 0x00014a94 at +0x20. Returns ctrl. Side effects: writes ctrl. Callers: 2 (world_blackjack_human_construct, world_blackjack_ai_construct).
Gives a slot's controller object its context: table +0x14, own side +0x18, opposing side +0x1c. No return value. Side effects: writes the object. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_game_setup_players).

Loads the slot's controller object and tail-jumps to world_blackjack_obj_run_phase0 (pick a card; io = {choice, total}). Returns 1 when the phase finished this call, else 0. Side effects: those of the phase methods. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_side_state0_pick).

Loads the slot's controller object and tail-jumps to world_blackjack_obj_run_phase1 (decide whether to draw another card from the deck; io[0] = answer). Returns 1 when finished. Side effects: those of the phase methods. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_side_state2_draw_again).

Loads the slot's controller object and tail-jumps to world_blackjack_obj_run_phase2 (continue or stand; io = {answer, own total, other total, turn}). Returns 1 when finished. Side effects: those of the phase methods. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_side_state13_ask_continue).

Loads the slot's controller object and tail-jumps to world_blackjack_obj_run_phase3 (partner hint; io = {cursor slot, card id}). Returns 1 when finished (never for the AI hint). Side effects: those of the phase methods. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_side_state0_pick).

Resets the phase state of a controller object: active-phase bits +0 = 0 and the four pending-start flags +4..+0x10 = 1. No return value. Side effects: writes ctrl. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_human_init); also slot +8 of the AI vtable (word 0x00014a54) and of the base vtable (word 0x00014a9c), run through +8 by world_blackjack_ctrl_create.
Returns 1 (empty tear-down helper; ctrl is ignored). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_human_term); also the tear-down slot +0xc of the AI controller vtable 0x00014a4c (word 0x00014a58).

Sets bit phase in the active-phase word +0. No return value. Side effects: writes ctrl. Callers: 4 (world_blackjack_obj_run_phase3, world_blackjack_obj_run_phase0, world_blackjack_obj_run_phase1, world_blackjack_obj_run_phase2).

Ends a phase: clears its active bit (world_blackjack_ctrl_clear_phase_bits) and sets its pending-start flag +4 + phase * 4 = 1 so the next run calls the start method again. No return value. Side effects: writes ctrl. Callers: 4 (world_blackjack_obj_run_phase0, world_blackjack_obj_run_phase1, world_blackjack_obj_run_phase2, world_blackjack_obj_run_phase3); also the tail jump of world_blackjack_ai_on_card_taken (world_blackjack_ai_on_card_taken) with phase 3.

Clears the bits of mask in the active-phase word +0 and sets the pending-start flag (+4 + i * 4) of every phase i (0-3) contained in mask. No return value. Side effects: writes ctrl. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_ctrl_finish_phase).
Returns the active bit of phase in word +0 (non-zero when active). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_obj_draw_phases).

Draws a controller: for each active phase 0-3 calls its draw method (vtable +0x20, +0x2c, +0x38, +0x44) with list, chaining the returned list. Returns the list. Side effects: those of the draw methods. No direct caller (reached by the tail jump of world_blackjack_ctrl_draw).

Runs phase 0 (pick) of a controller: when the pending flag +4 is set calls the start method (vtable +0x18), marks the phase active and clears the flag (returns 0); otherwise calls the poll method (vtable +0x1c) and, when it returns non-zero, finishes the phase (world_blackjack_ctrl_finish_phase) and returns 1. Side effects: ctrl, those of the methods. No direct caller (tail jump from world_blackjack_ctrl_run_pick).

Runs phase 1 (draw again) of a controller: pending flag +8, start method vtable +0x24, poll method +0x28; returns 1 when the poll finished, else 0. Side effects: ctrl, those of the methods. No direct caller (tail jump from world_blackjack_ctrl_run_draw_again).

Runs phase 2 (continue or stand) of a controller: pending flag +0xc, start method vtable +0x30, poll +0x34; returns 1 when the poll finished, else 0. Side effects: ctrl, those of the methods. No direct caller (tail jump from world_blackjack_ctrl_run_continue).

Runs phase 3 (hint) of a controller: pending flag +0x10, start method vtable +0x3c, poll +0x40; returns 1 when the poll finished, else 0. Side effects: ctrl, those of the methods. No direct caller (tail jump from world_blackjack_ctrl_run_hint).

Initialises the card table: next-card index +0x438 = 0, owner +0x440, image phase +0x444 = 0, the 27 card objects (0x28 bytes each from +0) with world_blackjack_card_init, then creates the table model instance from resource 6 (field_3d_create_model_instance, +0x43c), binds animation resource 7 and plays animation 0 with flags 2. Returns 1. Side effects: table, model allocation. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_create).
Tears down the table: world_blackjack_card_term for the 27 cards and destroys the model instance +0x43c. Returns 1. Side effects: model freed, +0x43c = 0. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_destroy).

Steps the animation of all 27 cards (world_blackjack_card_animate); while +0x444 is 0 checks whether every card's cardm image is ready (world_blackjack_card_image_ready) and then sets +0x444 = 1 and requests the cardh images of all cards (world_blackjack_card_request_image_h). No return value. Side effects: cards, +0x444, CIP requests. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_update_deal).

Draws the table on layer 1 (depth test off): slots in the 0x1c-entry order table 0x000135b8, each occupied slot's card unless it is moving, on top, or the hovered hand card (cursor slot 7-0x1a); then on layer 2 the hovered hand card, the moving cards and the on-top cards (world_blackjack_card_draw); finally the table model +0x43c with a matrix translated by the vector at 0x00013d00 and scaled by 2.0 (field_3d_draw_model with draw flags {1, 2}). Leaves layer 1 selected. No return value. Side effects: display lists of layers 1 and 2, GU matrix stack. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_draw_all).
Returns the cursor slot +0x4d4 of the table (0 deck, 1-6 field, 7-0x1a hands). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_blackjack_table_draw, world_blackjack_human_pick_poll).

Builds a new shuffled 27-card deck (world_blackjack_build_deck), resets the image phase +0x444, stores each id in its card object (world_blackjack_card_set_id) and requests its cardm image (world_blackjack_card_request_image). No return value. Side effects: cards, CIP requests, heap (inside build_deck). Callers: 1 (thunk to world_blackjack_game_deal_deck).
Returns non-zero when the cardm images of the first 8 card objects are ready (world_blackjack_card_image_ready). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_images_ready).
Returns the next undealt card object (table + index * 0x28) and increments the index +0x438. Side effects: +0x438. Callers: 2 (world_blackjack_table_move_card, world_blackjack_table_set_deck_top).

Builds the blackjack deck: scans card ids 0xe88-0x1f39 that are valid, present in the cardm CIP, not tokens and not one of 0x1388, 0xecb, 0x1386, 0xeb3, 0x1387, 0xece, 0xea8, 0xecd, 0x1b4d, and buckets them as monsters by level 1-12, frame-7 cards and frame-8 cards (two passes: count, then fill malloc'd arrays). Fills a 40-entry pool repeating 20 monsters (level bucket j % 12, random member), 10 random frame-7 and 10 random frame-8 cards, shuffles it (40 random swaps), then forces entries 6 and 7 to random monsters, copies the first count ids to out and frees the arrays. Note: a bucket with 0 members would divide by zero (not guarded). No return value. Side effects: heap alloc/free, random numbers, out. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_table_deal_deck).

Prepares the 3D view for a frame: world_blackjack_init_ge_state(list) and world_blackjack_set_camera. Returns the advanced list. Side effects: display list, GU matrices. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_draw).

Writes the frame's 3D render state: offset (0x710, 0x778), viewport 480 x 272 at (0x800, 0x800), depth range, alpha blending, scissor, alpha test, depth test (func 7), front face, shading, fog (50-100, colour 0x404040, then disabled), orthographic projection (-240..240, -136..136, +-10000) scaled by the vector 0x00013d10, identity view/model, clear colour 0xff000000 / depth 0 / stencil 0 (clear flags 0x17), linear filtering and white ambient with lighting on and light 0 off. Returns the advanced list (Ghidra shows void). Side effects: display list, GU matrices. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_setup_3d_view).

Sets the fixed table camera: view matrix from field_3d_camera_set_look_at(eye 0x00013d20, target 0x00013d30, up 0x00013d40), marks it dirty and loads identity into the model matrix. Returns list unchanged. Side effects: GU view/model matrices. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_setup_3d_view).

column2: int world_blackjack_init(int character, int variant, int opp1_character, int opp1_variant, int opp2_character, int opp2_variant)
column3: Initialises the mini-game: field_3d render state on layer 0, model allocator (world_blackjack_heap_alloc / world_blackjack_heap_free), releases all sound banks and loads banks 0x2c8 and 0x2d0, creates the module heap and opens the card CIPs (world_blackjack_open_card_archives), clears the globals 0x00014b40..0x00015860 (0xd20 bytes), state 0x00014b40 = 0, draw flag 0x00014b44 = 1, intro flag 0x000157d4 = 1, stores the six arguments at 0x00014b48..0x00014b5c (partner character/variant and the two opponents, -1 = random) and the save mini-game block pointer (save_get_minigame_block_0) at 0x0001584c, and resets the popup system (world_blackjack_popup_reset). Returns 1. Side effects: globals, sound banks, heap, CIP readers. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_scene_init).

Returns 0 while running, 1 when finished. Side effects: all mini-game globals. Callers: 1 (world_blackjack_scene_step).

Frame drawing (when the draw flag 0x00014b44 is set and the state is above 0): layer 0 3D view setup; on layer 1 for states 5-0xc the background, the score panel and the game (world_blackjack_draw_background, world_blackjack_draw_score_panel, world_blackjack_game_draw); on layer 4 the screen fade, the message window in state 10, the intro layout in states 3-8 while 0x000157d4 is set, the round banner (dictionary word 0xb formatted with round 0x00014b6c + 1, outlined text at (0x78, 200) fading in over 15 frames, held, then out until frame 0x3c of 0x00015840), and the result screen in state 0xe; finally the popup draw.
